name: synthetic-rate-limited
description: Fuse refuses a POST outright: 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After, the refusal every POST endpoint can answer with. Vendor non-2xx is DATA: the engine classifies it as a provider error and forces zero usage. Synthetic, shaped on Fuse's published Business API contract (2026-10-29).

error.message: You have exceeded the rate limit. Please retry after the window resets.
